```html
        <div class="your-rank-card mb-4" id="yourRankCard" style="display: none;">
            <div>
                <div class="rank-label">Your Rank</div>
                <div class="rank-number" id="yourRank">#0</div>
            </div>
            <div class="rank-earnings">
                <div class="rank-label">Your Earnings</div>
                <div class="amount" id="yourEarnings">₹0</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Top 3 Podium -->
        <div id="topThreeContainer" class="row g-3 mb-4">
            <div class="col-12 text-center text-secondary py-4">
                <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                <p class="mt-2">Loading top earners...</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Full List -->
        <h5 class="text-white mb-3"><i class="fas fa-list me-2"></i>All Rankings</h5>
        <div class="card bg-dark text-white border-secondary" id="leaderboardList">
            <div class="card-body text-center text-secondary py-4">
                <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                <p class="mt-2">Loading rankings...</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Achievement Badge -->
        <div class="mt-4 text-center">
            <div class="card bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                <div class="card-body py-3">
                    <i class="fas fa-medal fa-2x text-warning mb-1"></i>
                    <p class="text-secondary small mb-0">Keep inviting friends and completing tasks to climb the leaderboard!</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    BOTTOM NAVIGATION - FIXED
    ============================================ -->
    
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="withdraw.html" class="nav-link" data-page="withdraw">
                <i class="fas fa-money-bill-wave"></i>
                <span>Withdraw</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Toast Container -->
    <div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3"></div>

    <!-- Bootstrap JS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <script>
    // ============================================
    // ✅ AUTH CHECK - NO REDIRECT LOOP
    // ============================================
    
    const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
    const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
    
    if (!token || !userData) {
        window.location.replace('/login.html');
    }
    
    console.log('✅ User authenticated, loading leaderboard');
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ PRIVACY FUNCTION - Hide Name
    // ============================================
    
    function hideName(name) {
        if (!name) return 'User';
        name = name.trim();
        const parts = name.split(' ');
        const firstName = parts[0] || '';
        const lastName = parts.slice(1).join(' ') || '';
        
        let hiddenFirstName = firstName;
        if (firstName.length > 3) {
            hiddenFirstName = firstName.substring(0, firstName.length - 3) + '***';
        } else if (firstName.length > 1) {
            hiddenFirstName = firstName.charAt(0) + '**';
        }
        
        let hiddenLastName = lastName;
        if (lastName.length > 2) {
            hiddenLastName = lastName.substring(0, lastName.length - 2) + '**';
        } else if (lastName.length > 0) {
            hiddenLastName = lastName.charAt(0) + '*';
        }
        
        if (hiddenLastName && hiddenLastName !== '*') {
            return hiddenFirstName + ' ' + hiddenLastName;
        }
        return hiddenFirstName;
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ STATE
    // ============================================
    
    let currentPeriod = 'weekly';
    let currentUserId = null;
    let currentUserName = '';
    
    try {
        const user = JSON.parse(userData);
        currentUserId = user.id;
        currentUserName = user.full_name || 'User';
        // ✅ Update wallet balance from localStorage (fallback)
        const balance = parseFloat(user.wallet_balance || 0);
        document.getElementById('walletBalance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(balance);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error parsing user data:', e);
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ UPDATE WALLET BALANCE IN TOP BAR
    // ============================================
    
    function updateWalletBalance(balance) {
        const walletEl = document.getElementById('walletBalance');
        if (walletEl) {
            const rounded = Math.round(balance || 0);
            walletEl.textContent = '₹' + rounded;
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ LOAD LEADERBOARD
    // ============================================
    
    async function loadLeaderboard(period = 'weekly') {
        currentPeriod = period;
        
        // Update active filter
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.period === period);
        });
        
        // Show loading
        document.getElementById('topThreeContainer').innerHTML = `
            <div class="col-12 text-center text-secondary py-4">
                <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                <p class="mt-2">Loading top earners...</p>
            </div>
        `;
        document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = `
            <div class="card-body text-center text-secondary py-4">
                <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                <p class="mt-2">Loading rankings...</p>
            </div>
        `;
        document.getElementById('yourRankCard').style.display = 'none';
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`https://paisa-pay.online/api/leaderboard/index.php?period=${period}`, {
                headers: {
                    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                }
            });
            
            if (response.status === 401) {
                localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                window.location.replace('/login.html');
                return;
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (!data.success) {
                showToast(data.message || 'Error loading leaderboard', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const result = data.data;
            
            // ✅ Update wallet balance in top bar from API
            updateWalletBalance(result.balance || result.user_wallet || 0);
            
            // Render top 3
            renderTopThree(result.top_three || []);
            
            // Render your rank
            renderYourRank(result);
            
            // Render full list
            renderLeaderboardList(result.rankings || [], result.user_position);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Leaderboard error:', error);
            showToast('Error loading leaderboard', 'error');
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ RENDER TOP 3
    // ============================================
    
    function renderTopThree(users) {
        const container = document.getElementById('topThreeContainer');
        
        if (!users || users.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="col-12">
                    <div class="card bg-dark text-white text-center py-4 border-secondary">
                        <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-2"></i>
                        <p class="text-secondary mb-0">No rankings yet. Be the first!</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            return;
        }
        
        const medals = ['🥇', '🥈', '🥉'];
        const classes = ['gold', 'silver', 'bronze'];
        
        while (users.length < 3) {
            users.push({ full_name: '---', total_earnings: 0 });
        }
        
        const top3 = users.slice(0, 3);
        
        container.innerHTML = top3.map((user, index) => {
            let displayName = user.full_name || 'User';
            if (user.id != currentUserId) {
                displayName = hideName(displayName);
            }
            
            const earningAmount = Math.round(user.total_earnings || 0);
            
            return `
                <div class="col-4">
                    <div class="podium-card ${classes[index] || ''}">
                        <div class="rank-num">#${index + 1}</div>
                        <div class="medal">${medals[index] || ''}</div>
                        <div class="name">${displayName}</div>
                        <div class="earnings">₹${earningAmount}</div>
                        <div class="sub">${user.referral_count || 0} referrals</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join('');
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ RENDER YOUR RANK
    // ============================================
    
    function renderYourRank(data) {
        const card = document.getElementById('yourRankCard');
        
        if (data.user_position && data.user_position > 0) {
            card.style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('yourRank').textContent = '#' + data.user_position;
            const userEarnings = Math.round(data.user_earnings || 0);
            document.getElementById('yourEarnings').textContent = '₹' + userEarnings;
        } else {
            card.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ RENDER LEADERBOARD LIST
    // ============================================
    
    function renderLeaderboardList(rankings, userPosition) {
        const container = document.getElementById('leaderboardList');
        
        if (!rankings || rankings.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="card-body text-center text-secondary py-4">
                    <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-2"></i>
                    <p class="mb-0">No rankings available for this period</p>
                </div>
            `;
            return;
        }
        
        const displayRankings = rankings.slice(0, 100);
        
        let html = '<div class="card-body p-0">';
        
        displayRankings.forEach((user, index) => {
            const rank = index + 1;
            const isUser = user.is_user || (currentUserId && user.id == currentUserId);
            
            let positionClass = 'position';
            if (rank === 1) positionClass += ' top1';
            else if (rank === 2) positionClass += ' top2';
            else if (rank === 3) positionClass += ' top3';
            
            let medal = '';
            if (rank === 1) medal = '🥇';
            else if (rank === 2) medal = '🥈';
            else if (rank === 3) medal = '🥉';
            
            let displayName = user.full_name || 'User';
            if (!isUser) {
                displayName = hideName(displayName);
            }
            
            const earningAmount = Math.round(user.total_earnings || 0);
            
            html += `
                <div class="rank-list-item ${isUser ? 'current-user' : ''}">
                    <div class="${positionClass}">
                        ${medal || rank}
                    </div>
                    <div class="user-info">
                        <div class="name">
                            ${displayName}
                            ${isUser ? '<span class="badge-you">YOU</span>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div class="sub">${user.referral_count || 0} referrals · ${user.task_count || 0} tasks</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="user-earnings">
                        ₹${earningAmount}
                        <span class="label">earned</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        html += '</div>';
        
        if (rankings.length > 100) {
            html += `<div class="text-center text-secondary py-2 small">Showing top 100 of ${rankings.length}</div>`;
        }
        
        container.innerHTML = html;
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ TOAST
    // ============================================
    
    function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
        
        const colors = {
            success: 'bg-success',
            error: 'bg-danger',
            warning: 'bg-warning',
            info: 'bg-info'
        };
        
        const toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
        toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        toast.innerHTML = `
            <div class="d-flex">
                <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
            </div>
        `;
        
        let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }
        
        container.appendChild(toast);
        const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
        bsToast.show();
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ LOAD ON PAGE LOAD
    // ============================================
    
    loadLeaderboard('weekly');
    
    setInterval(() => {
        loadLeaderboard(currentPeriod);
    }, 60000);
    
    console.log('✅ Leaderboard loaded successfully');
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
        /* ============================================
           TOAST STYLES

        @media (max-width: 480px) {

        /* ============================================

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .login-card {
                padding: 28px 18px;
                border-radius: 22px;
            }
            
            .login-logo .logo-icon {
                width: 64px;
                height: 64px;
                font-size: 28px;
                border-radius: 18px;
            }
            
            .login-logo h2 {
                font-size: 22px;
            }
            
            .form-control {
                padding: 12px 14px;
                min-height: 48px;
                font-size: 14px;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
            
            .btn-primary-custom {
                font-size: 15px;
                padding: 14px 20px;
                min-height: 50px;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
            
            .alert-custom {
                padding: 12px 14px;
                font-size: 13px;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
        }
        
        @media (max-width: 360px) {
            .login-card {
                padding: 20px 14px;
                border-radius: 18px;
            }
            
            .login-logo .logo-icon {
                width: 56px;
                height: 56px;
                font-size: 24px;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
            
            .login-logo h2 {
                font-size: 20px;
            }
            
            .form-control {
                padding: 10px 12px;
                min-height: 44px;
                font-size: 13px;
            }
            
            .btn-primary-custom {
                font-size: 14px;
                padding: 12px 16px;
                min-height: 46px;
            }
        }
        
        .forgot-link {
            color: #64748b;
            font-size: 13px;
            text-decoration: none;
            float: right;
            margin-top: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }
        
        .forgot-link:hover {
            color: #8B5CF6;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="login-container">
        <div class="login-card">
            
            <!-- ============================================
            ALERTS - TOP OF CARD
            ============================================ -->
            
            <div class="alert-container">
                <div class="alert-custom alert-error" id="errorAlert">
                    <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
                    <span id="errorMessage">Invalid email or password</span>
                    <button class="close-btn" onclick="hideError()">✕</button>
                </div>
                
                <div class="alert-custom alert-success" id="successAlert">
                    <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
                    <span id="successMessage">OTP sent successfully!</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- ============================================
            LOGO
            ============================================ -->
            
            <div class="login-logo">
                <div class="logo-icon">
                    <i class="fas fa-wallet"></i>
                </div>
                <h2>PaisaPay</h2>
                <p>Welcome back! Login to your account</p>
            </div>

            <!-- ============================================
            LOGIN FORM
            ============================================ -->
            
            <form id="loginForm" novalidate>
                
                <!-- Email -->
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Email Address <span class="required">*</span></label>
                    <input type="email" class="form-control" id="emailInput" placeholder="your@email.com" required autofocus>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Password -->
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Password <span class="required">*</span></label>
                    <input type="password" class="form-control" id="passwordInput" placeholder="Enter your password" required>
                    <span class="forgot-link" onclick="forgotPassword()">Forgot password?</span>
                </div><br>
                
                <!-- Submit Button -->
                <button type="submit" class="btn-primary-custom" id="loginBtn">
                    <i class="fas fa-sign-in-alt me-2"></i>
                    <span id="btnText">Sign In</span>
                </button>
            </form>
            
            <!-- ============================================
            DIVIDER & FOOTER
            ============================================ -->
            
            <div class="divider">
                <span class="line"></span>
                <span class="text">Secure Access</span>
                <span class="line"></span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="login-footer">
                <p>Don't have an account? <a href="signup.html">Sign Up</a></p>
                <span class="terms">
                    By continuing, you agree to our <a href="help.html">Terms &amp; Conditions</a> and <a href="help.html">Privacy Policy</a>
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Toast Container -->
    <div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3"></div>

    <!-- Bootstrap JS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
        // ============================================
        // ✅ CHECK IF ALREADY LOGGED IN
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
        
        if (token && userData) {
            fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/auth/validate.php', {
                headers: {
                    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                }
            })
            .then(response => response.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.valid) {
                    window.location.replace('/dashboard.html');
                } else {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
            });
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ CHECK FOR VERIFICATION MESSAGE
        // ============================================
        
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const email = urlParams.get('email');
            const verified = urlParams.get('verified');
            
            if (email && verified === 'false') {
                showToast('📧 Please check your email (' + email + ') to verify your account before logging in.', 'info');
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, '/login.html');
            }
            
            if (verified === 'true') {
                showToast('✅ Email verified! You can now login.', 'success');
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, '/login.html');
            }
        });
        
        console.log('✅ Login page loaded');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ DOM ELEMENTS
        // ============================================
        
        const loginForm = document.getElementById('loginForm');
        const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('passwordInput');
        const loginBtn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
        const btnText = document.getElementById('btnText');
        
        const errorAlert = document.getElementById('errorAlert');
        const errorMessage = document.getElementById('errorMessage');
        const successAlert = document.getElementById('successAlert');
        const successMessage = document.getElementById('successMessage');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TOAST FUNCTION
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 5000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ ALERT FUNCTIONS
        // ============================================
        
        function showError(msg) {
            errorMessage.textContent = msg;
            errorAlert.classList.add('show');
            successAlert.classList.remove('show');
            clearTimeout(window.errorTimeout);
            window.errorTimeout = setTimeout(hideError, 5000);
        }
        
        function hideError() {
            errorAlert.classList.remove('show');
        }
        
        function showSuccess(msg) {
            successMessage.textContent = msg;
            successAlert.classList.add('show');
            errorAlert.classList.remove('show');
            clearTimeout(window.successTimeout);
            window.successTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                successAlert.classList.remove('show');
            }, 3000);
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOGIN HANDLER
        // ============================================
        
        loginForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            hideError();
            successAlert.classList.remove('show');
            
            const email = emailInput.value.trim();
            const password = passwordInput.value.trim();
            
            if (!email || !password) {
                showError('Please enter email and password');
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                loginBtn.disabled = true;
                btnText.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm me-2"></span>Signing in...';
                
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/auth/login.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    localStorage.setItem('auth_token', data.token);
                    localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(data.user));
                    
                    showSuccess('✅ Login successful! Redirecting...');
                    
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.location.replace('/dashboard.html');
                    }, 1000);
                } else {
                    showError(data.message || 'Login failed');
                    loginBtn.disabled = false;
                    btnText.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sign-in-alt me-2"></i>Sign In';
                }
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Login error:', error);
                loginBtn.disabled = false;
                btnText.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sign-in-alt me-2"></i>Sign In';
                showError('Connection error. Please try again.');
            }
        });
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ FORGOT PASSWORD
        // ============================================
        
        async function forgotPassword() {
            const email = emailInput.value.trim();
            
            if (!email) {
                showError('Please enter your email address first');
                emailInput.focus();
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/auth/forgot-password.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ email })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    showSuccess('✅ Password reset link sent to your email!');
                } else {
                    showError(data.message || 'Failed to send reset link');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                showError('Connection error. Please try again.');
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ ENTER KEY SUPPORT
        // ============================================
        
        passwordInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                loginForm.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit'));
            }
        });
        
        emailInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                passwordInput.focus();
            }
        });
        
        console.log('✅ Login page ready');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

```php
<?php
// backend/middleware/admin.php

require_once __DIR__ . '/auth.php';

function requireAdmin() {
    $user = authenticate();
    
    // Check if user is admin
    // You need to have an admins table or a role field in users table
    // For this implementation, we'll check if the user exists in admins table
    
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        SELECT id, role, full_name 
        FROM admins 
        WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$user['user_id']]);
    $admin = $stmt->fetch();
    
    if (!$admin) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Forbidden - Admin access required'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    return [
        'user_id' => $admin['id'],
        'role' => $admin['role'],
        'full_name' => $admin['full_name']
    ];
}
```

## `public_html/middleware/auth.php`

```php
<?php
// backend/middleware/auth.php

require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../classes/JWTHandler.php';

/**
 * Authenticate user using JWT token
 * 
 * @return array Decoded user data from token
 * @throws Exception If authentication fails
 */
function authenticate() {
    // Get token from header
    $token = getTokenFromHeader();
    
    if (!$token) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Unauthorized - No token provided',
            'code' => 'NO_TOKEN'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    // Verify token
    $decoded = JWTHandler::verify($token);
    
    if (!$decoded) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Unauthorized - Invalid or expired token',
            'code' => 'INVALID_TOKEN'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    // Check if user exists and is active
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        SELECT id, full_name, phone_number, is_active, is_blocked, is_verified 
        FROM users 
        WHERE id = ?
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$decoded['user_id']]);
    $user = $stmt->fetch();
    
    if (!$user) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Unauthorized - User not found',
            'code' => 'USER_NOT_FOUND'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    if (!$user['is_active']) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Account is inactive. Please contact support.',
            'code' => 'ACCOUNT_INACTIVE'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    if ($user['is_blocked']) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Account is blocked. Please contact support.',
            'code' => 'ACCOUNT_BLOCKED'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    // Return user data
    return [
        'user_id' => $user['id'],
        'full_name' => $user['full_name'],
        'phone_number' => $user['phone_number'],
        'is_verified' => $user['is_verified'],
        'is_active' => $user['is_active'],
        'is_blocked' => $user['is_blocked']
    ];
}

/**
 * Get token from Authorization header
 * 
 * @return string|null Token or null if not found
 */
function getTokenFromHeader() {
    $headers = getallheaders();
    
    // Try different header formats
    $authHeader = '';
    
    if (isset($headers['Authorization'])) {
        $authHeader = $headers['Authorization'];
    } elseif (isset($headers['authorization'])) {
        $authHeader = $headers['authorization'];
    } elseif (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])) {
        $authHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'];
    } elseif (isset($_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])) {
        $authHeader = $_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'];
    }
    
    // Check if it's a Bearer token
    if (preg_match('/Bearer\s(\S+)/', $authHeader, $matches)) {
        return $matches[1];
    }
    
    // Also check for token in query string (for debugging)
    if (isset($_GET['token'])) {
        return $_GET['token'];
    }
    
    return null;
}

/**
 * Get user ID from token without full authentication
 * 
 * @return int|null User ID or null if invalid
 */
function getUserIdFromToken() {
    $token = getTokenFromHeader();
    
    if (!$token) {
        return null;
    }
    
    $decoded = JWTHandler::verify($token);
    
    if (!$decoded) {
        return null;
    }
    
    return $decoded['user_id'] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Check if user is authenticated (returns boolean)
 * 
 * @return bool
 */
function isAuthenticated() {
    try {
        $token = getTokenFromHeader();
        if (!$token) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $decoded = JWTHandler::verify($token);
        if (!$decoded) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if user exists
        $db = Database::getInstance();
        $conn = $db->getConnection();
        
        $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ? AND is_active = 1 AND is_blocked = 0");
        $stmt->execute([$decoded['user_id']]);
        
        return $stmt->fetch() !== false;
        
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Require verification status
 * 
 * @param bool $verified Whether user must be verified
 * @throws Exception
 */
function requireVerification($verified = true) {
    $user = authenticate();
    
    if ($verified && !$user['is_verified']) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Phone number not verified. Please verify your phone number first.',
            'code' => 'NOT_VERIFIED'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
}

/**
 * Get current user data
 * 
 * @return array|null User data or null
 */
function getCurrentUser() {
    try {
        $token = getTokenFromHeader();
        if (!$token) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $decoded = JWTHandler::verify($token);
        if (!$decoded) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $db = Database::getInstance();
        $conn = $db->getConnection();
        
        $stmt = $conn->prepare("
            SELECT id, full_name, phone_number, email, referral_code, 
                   wallet_balance, total_earnings, is_verified, is_active, is_blocked
            FROM users 
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$decoded['user_id']]);
        
        return $stmt->fetch();
        
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Rate limiting middleware
 * 
 * @param string $key Rate limit key (e.g., 'api_login')
 * @param int $limit Number of requests allowed
 * @param int $window Time window in seconds
 * @return bool
 */
function rateLimit($key, $limit = 60, $window = 60) {
    $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
    $cacheKey = "rate_limit_{$key}_{$ip}";
    
    // Simple file-based rate limiting (for shared hosting)
    $cacheDir = __DIR__ . '/../cache/';
    if (!is_dir($cacheDir)) {
        mkdir($cacheDir, 0755, true);
    }
    
    $cacheFile = $cacheDir . md5($cacheKey) . '.cache';
    $currentTime = time();
    
    if (file_exists($cacheFile)) {
        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents($cacheFile), true);
        
        // Reset if window has passed
        if ($currentTime - $data['time'] > $window) {
            $data = ['count' => 1, 'time' => $currentTime];
        } else {
            $data['count']++;
        }
    } else {
        $data = ['count' => 1, 'time' => $currentTime];
    }
    
    file_put_contents($cacheFile, json_encode($data));
    
    if ($data['count'] > $limit) {
        http_response_code(429);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Too many requests. Please try again later.',
            'code' => 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
            'retry_after' => $window - ($currentTime - $data['time'])
        ]);
        exit;
    }
    
    return true;
}

/**
 * CORS middleware
 */
function handleCORS() {
    // Allow from any origin
    header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *');
    header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS');
    header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Accept, Origin');
    header('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true');
    header('Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400'); // 24 hours
    
    // Handle preflight requests
    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] == 'OPTIONS') {
        http_response_code(200);
        exit;
    }
}

/**
 * Security headers middleware
 */
function securityHeaders() {
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    header('X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block');
    header('X-Frame-Options: DENY');
    header('Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
    header("Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:;");
}

/**
 * Input validation middleware
 * 
 * @param array $data Input data
 * @param array $rules Validation rules
 * @return bool
 * @throws Exception
 */
function validateInput($data, $rules) {
    foreach ($rules as $field => $rule) {
        $value = $data[$field] ?? null;
        
        // Required check
        if (strpos($rule, 'required') !== false && empty($value)) {
            throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' is required");
        }
        
        // Type checks
        if (strpos($rule, 'numeric') !== false && !is_numeric($value)) {
            throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must be numeric");
        }
        
        if (strpos($rule, 'email') !== false && !filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must be a valid email address");
        }
        
        if (strpos($rule, 'phone') !== false && !preg_match('/^[0-9]{10,15}$/', $value)) {
            throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must be a valid phone number");
        }
        
        // Min length
        if (preg_match('/min:(\d+)/', $rule, $matches)) {
            $min = intval($matches[1]);
            if (strlen($value) < $min) {
                throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must be at least {$min} characters");
            }
        }
        
        // Max length
        if (preg_match('/max:(\d+)/', $rule, $matches)) {
            $max = intval($matches[1]);
            if (strlen($value) > $max) {
                throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must not exceed {$max} characters");
            }
        }
        
        // In array
        if (preg_match('/in:([^,]+(?:,[^,]+)*)/', $rule, $matches)) {
            $allowed = array_map('trim', explode(',', $matches[1]));
            if (!in_array($value, $allowed)) {
                throw new Exception("Field '{$field}' must be one of: " . implode(', ', $allowed));
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

/**
 * Sanitize input data
 * 
 * @param mixed $data Input data
 * @return mixed Sanitized data
 */
function sanitizeInput($data) {
    if (is_array($data)) {
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            $data[$key] = sanitizeInput($value);
        }
        return $data;
    }
    
    // Remove HTML tags
    $data = strip_tags($data);
    
    // Convert special characters to HTML entities
    $data = htmlspecialchars($data, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    
    // Trim whitespace
    $data = trim($data);
    
    return $data;
}

/**
 * Log authentication events
 * 
 * @param int $userId User ID
 * @param string $action Action performed
 * @param array $details Additional details
 */
function logAuthEvent($userId, $action, $details = []) {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        INSERT INTO activity_logs (user_id, action, details, ip_address, user_agent, created_at) 
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
    ");
    $stmt->execute([
        $userId,
        $action,
        json_encode($details),
        $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'unknown',
        $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? 'unknown'
    ]);
}

// Auto-handle CORS and security headers
handleCORS();
securityHeaders();

// Check maintenance mode (only for non-admin requests)
function checkMaintenanceMode() {
    // Skip for admin routes
    $uri = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '';
    if (strpos($uri, '/api/admin/') !== false) {
        return;
    }
    
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT setting_value FROM settings WHERE setting_key = 'maintenance_mode'");
    $stmt->execute();
    $maintenance = $stmt->fetch()['setting_value'] ?? 'false';
    
    if ($maintenance === 'true') {
        http_response_code(503);
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Application is under maintenance. Please try again later.',
            'code' => 'MAINTENANCE_MODE'
        ]);
        exit;
    }
}

// Check maintenance mode
checkMaintenanceMode();
```

```html
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Member Since -->
                <div class="detail-item">
                    <div class="label"><i class="fas fa-calendar me-1"></i>Member Since</div>
                    <div class="value" id="profileMemberSince">--</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3 pt-3" style="border-top: 1px solid #1a2234;">
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="saveProfile()">
                    <i class="fas fa-save me-2"></i>Save Changes
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" onclick="resetProfile()">
                    <i class="fas fa-undo me-2"></i>Reset
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    ADD PHONE MODAL
    ============================================ -->
    
    <div class="modal fade" id="phoneModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h6 class="modal-title text-white"><i class="fas fa-phone me-2" style="color: #60a5fa;"></i>Add Phone Number</h6>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <form id="phoneForm">
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Country Code</label>
                            <select class="form-control" id="phoneCountryCode">
                                <option value="+91">🇮🇳 +91 (India)</option>
                                <option value="+1">🇺🇸 +1 (USA)</option>
                                <option value="+44">🇬🇧 +44 (UK)</option>
                                <option value="+61">🇦🇺 +61 (Australia)</option>
                                <option value="+81">🇯🇵 +81 (Japan)</option>
                                <option value="+86">🇨🇳 +86 (China)</option>
                                <option value="+92">🇵🇰 +92 (Pakistan)</option>
                                <option value="+880">🇧🇩 +880 (Bangladesh)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Phone Number</label>
                            <input type="tel" class="form-control" id="phoneNumberInput" placeholder="Enter phone number" required>
                            <div class="form-text">Enter your phone number without the country code</div>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Cancel</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="savePhoneNumber()">Save Phone Number</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- BOTTOM NAV -->
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="profile.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="profile">
                <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
                <span>Profile</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <div class="toast-container"></div>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
        // ============================================
        // AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }

        let profileData = null;
        let originalData = null;
        let isEditing = false;

        // ============================================
        // API ENDPOINTS
        // ============================================
        
        const API_BASE = '/api';
        const PROFILE_ENDPOINT = `${API_BASE}/user/profile.php`;

        // ============================================
        // LOAD PROFILE
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadProfile() {
            try {
                showToast('Loading profile...', 'info');
                
                const response = await fetch(PROFILE_ENDPOINT, {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });

                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!result.success) {
                    showToast(result.message || 'Error loading profile', 'error');
                    return;
                }

                profileData = result.data;
                originalData = { ...result.data };
                renderProfile();
                showToast('Profile loaded successfully', 'success');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load profile error:', error);
                showToast('Error loading profile', 'error');
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // RENDER PROFILE
        // ============================================
        
        function renderProfile() {
            if (!profileData) return;
            
            document.getElementById('displayName').textContent = profileData.full_name || '--';
            document.getElementById('displayEmail').textContent = profileData.email || '--';
            document.getElementById('profileFullName').textContent = profileData.full_name || '--';
            document.getElementById('profileEmail').textContent = profileData.email || '--';
            document.getElementById('profileReferral').textContent = profileData.referral_code || '--';
            
            // Phone Number with Add option
            const phoneSpan = document.getElementById('profilePhone');
            const phoneActions = document.getElementById('phoneActions');
            
            if (profileData.phone_number && profileData.phone_number.trim() !== '') {
                phoneSpan.textContent = profileData.phone_number;
                phoneSpan.className = 'text-white';
                phoneActions.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="inline-edit-icon" onclick="editPhone()" title="Edit phone number">
                        <i class="fas fa-pen"></i>
                    </span>
                `;
            } else {
                phoneSpan.textContent = 'No phone number added';
                phoneSpan.className = 'phone-missing';
                phoneActions.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="openPhoneModal()">
                        <i class="fas fa-plus me-1"></i>Add Phone
                    </button>
                `;
            }
            
            if (profileData.created_at) {
                const date = new Date(profileData.created_at);
                document.getElementById('profileMemberSince').textContent = date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
                    day: 'numeric',
                    month: 'long',
                    year: 'numeric'
                });
            }
            
            const badge = document.getElementById('verifyBadge');
            if (profileData.is_verified) {
                badge.textContent = '✓ Verified';
                badge.className = 'badge bg-success';
            } else {
                badge.textContent = '⚠ Pending';
                badge.className = 'badge bg-warning';
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // EDIT NAME
        // ============================================
        
        function startEdit() {
            if (isEditing) return;
            isEditing = true;

            const span = document.getElementById('profileFullName');
            const container = span.parentElement;
            
            const editIcon = container.querySelector('.inline-edit-icon');
            if (editIcon) editIcon.style.display = 'none';

            const currentValue = profileData.full_name || '';

            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'text';
            input.className = 'edit-input';
            input.value = currentValue;
            input.placeholder = 'Enter full name';

            const actionDiv = document.createElement('div');
            actionDiv.className = 'd-flex gap-1';
            actionDiv.innerHTML = `
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-success save-btn"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></button>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger cancel-btn"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>
            `;

            span.style.display = 'none';
            container.appendChild(input);
            container.appendChild(actionDiv);
            input.focus();
            input.select();

            // Save
            actionDiv.querySelector('.save-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
                const newVal = input.value.trim();
                if (newVal === '') {
                    showToast('Name cannot be empty', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                profileData.full_name = newVal;
                span.textContent = newVal;
                span.style.display = 'inline';
                input.remove();
                actionDiv.remove();
                if (editIcon) editIcon.style.display = 'inline-block';
                isEditing = false;
                document.getElementById('displayName').textContent = newVal;
                showToast('Name updated. Click Save to persist.', 'success');
            });

            // Cancel
            actionDiv.querySelector('.cancel-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
                span.style.display = 'inline';
                input.remove();
                actionDiv.remove();
                if (editIcon) editIcon.style.display = 'inline-block';
                isEditing = false;
            });

            // Enter key
            input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    actionDiv.querySelector('.save-btn').click();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    actionDiv.querySelector('.cancel-btn').click();
                }
            });
        }

        // ============================================
        // EDIT PHONE (when phone exists)
        // ============================================
        
        function editPhone() {
            // Pre-fill the modal with current phone
            const currentPhone = profileData.phone_number || '';
            // Try to extract country code and number
            let countryCode = '+91';
            let number = currentPhone;
            
            // Simple extraction - if phone starts with +, try to split
            if (currentPhone.startsWith('+')) {
                const match = currentPhone.match(/^(\+\d+)(.*)/);
                if (match) {
                    countryCode = match[1];
                    number = match[2].trim();
                }
            }
            
            document.getElementById('phoneCountryCode').value = countryCode;
            document.getElementById('phoneNumberInput').value = number;
            
            // Change modal title to Edit
            document.querySelector('#phoneModal .modal-title').innerHTML = 
                '<i class="fas fa-phone me-2" style="color: #60a5fa;"></i>Edit Phone Number';
            
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('phoneModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // OPEN PHONE MODAL (when phone missing)
        // ============================================
        
        function openPhoneModal() {
            document.getElementById('phoneCountryCode').value = '+91';
            document.getElementById('phoneNumberInput').value = '';
            
            document.querySelector('#phoneModal .modal-title').innerHTML = 
                '<i class="fas fa-phone me-2" style="color: #60a5fa;"></i>Add Phone Number';
            
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('phoneModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // SAVE PHONE NUMBER
        // ============================================
        
        function savePhoneNumber() {
            const countryCode = document.getElementById('phoneCountryCode').value;
            const number = document.getElementById('phoneNumberInput').value.trim();
            
            if (!number) {
                showToast('Please enter a phone number', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            if (number.length < 10) {
                showToast('Please enter a valid phone number (min 10 digits)', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const fullPhone = countryCode + ' ' + number;
            profileData.phone_number = fullPhone;
            
            // Close modal
            const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('phoneModal'));
            modal.hide();
            
            // Update UI
            renderProfile();
            showToast('Phone number updated locally. Click Save to persist.', 'success');
        }

        // ============================================
        // SAVE PROFILE
        // ============================================
        
        async function saveProfile() {
            // Commit any pending edit
            if (isEditing) {
                const input = document.querySelector('.edit-input');
                if (input) {
                    const newVal = input.value.trim();
                    if (newVal === '') {
                        showToast('Name cannot be empty', 'error');
                        return;
                    }
                    profileData.full_name = newVal;
                    const container = input.parentElement;
                    const span = container.querySelector('span:not(.edit-input)');
                    if (span) {
                        span.textContent = newVal;
                        span.style.display = 'inline';
                    }
                    input.remove();
                    const actions = container.querySelector('.d-flex');
                    if (actions) actions.remove();
                    const editIcon = container.querySelector('.inline-edit-icon');
                    if (editIcon) editIcon.style.display = 'inline-block';
                    isEditing = false;
                }
            }

            // Check if anything changed
            if (originalData) {
                const nameChanged = profileData.full_name !== originalData.full_name;
                const phoneChanged = profileData.phone_number !== originalData.phone_number;
                
                if (!nameChanged && !phoneChanged) {
                    showToast('No changes to save', 'warning');
                    return;
                }
            }

            try {
                showToast('Saving...', 'info');
                
                const updateData = {
                    full_name: profileData.full_name,
                    phone_number: profileData.phone_number
                };
                
                const response = await fetch(PROFILE_ENDPOINT, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(updateData)
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (result.success) {
                    originalData = { ...profileData };
                    renderProfile();
                    showToast(result.message || 'Profile updated successfully', 'success');
                } else {
                    showToast(result.message || 'Error saving profile', 'error');
                }
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Save error:', error);
                showToast('Error saving profile', 'error');
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // RESET PROFILE
        // ============================================
        
        function resetProfile() {
            if (isEditing) {
                const input = document.querySelector('.edit-input');
                if (input) {
                    const container = input.parentElement;
                    const span = container.querySelector('span:not(.edit-input)');
                    if (span) {
                        span.style.display = 'inline';
                    }
                    input.remove();
                    const actions = container.querySelector('.d-flex');
                    if (actions) actions.remove();
                    const editIcon = container.querySelector('.inline-edit-icon');
                    if (editIcon) editIcon.style.display = 'inline-block';
                    isEditing = false;
                }
            }
            
            if (originalData) {
                profileData = { ...originalData };
                renderProfile();
                showToast('Profile reset to last saved state', 'info');
            } else {
                loadProfile();
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // COPY REFERRAL
        // ============================================
        
        function copyReferral() {
            const code = document.getElementById('profileReferral').textContent;
            if (code && code !== '--') {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                    showToast('Referral code copied!', 'success');
                }).catch(() => {
                    const input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.value = code;
                    document.body.appendChild(input);
                    input.select();
                    document.execCommand('copy');
                    document.body.removeChild(input);
                    showToast('Referral code copied!', 'success');
                });
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // INIT
        // ============================================
        
        loadProfile();
        console.log('✅ Profile page loaded');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
<body>

    <!-- TOP NAV IFRAME -->
    <iframe 
        src="/includes/nav.html" 
        style="width:100%; height:56px; border:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; z-index:1000; background:transparent !important; overflow:visible;"
        scrolling="no"
        id="navIframe"
        allowtransparency="true">
    </iframe>

    <script>
        window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
            var iframe = document.getElementById('navIframe');
            if (!iframe) return;
            if (event.data && event.data.type === 'expandNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '400px';
                iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
            } else if (event.data && event.data.type === 'collapseNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '56px';
                iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
            }
        });
    </script>

    <div class="container mt-3 mt-md-4 pb-5">
        
        <h5 class="text-white mb-4"><i class="fas fa-cog me-2" style="color: #8B5CF6;"></i>Settings</h5>

        <div class="settings-card">
            
            <!-- Profile Settings -->
            <div class="settings-item" onclick="window.location.href='profile.html'">

                    </div>
                    <div class="info">
                        <div class="title">Profile</div>
                        <div class="desc">Edit your personal information</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="arrow"><i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Change Password -->
            <div class="settings-item" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#passwordModal">
                <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                    <div class="icon" style="background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15); color: #fbbf24;">
                        <i class="fas fa-key"></i>

                    <div class="info">

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }

        // ============================================
        // TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // NOTIFICATIONS TOGGLE
        // ============================================
        
        document.getElementById('notifToggle').addEventListener('change', function() {
            const status = this.checked ? 'enabled' : 'disabled';
            showToast(`Notifications ${status}`, 'info');
            
            // Save preference to localStorage
            localStorage.setItem('notifications_enabled', this.checked ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        // ============================================
        // CHANGE PASSWORD
        // ============================================
        
        function changePassword() {
            const current = document.getElementById('currentPassword').value;
            const newPass = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirm = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            
            if (!current || !newPass || !confirm) {
                showToast('Please fill all fields', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            if (newPass.length < 8) {
                showToast('Password must be at least 8 characters', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            if (newPass !== confirm) {
                showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // API call to change password
            // For demo, we'll just show success
            showToast('Password changed successfully!', 'success');
            
            // Close modal
            const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('passwordModal'));
            modal.hide();
            
            // Reset form
            document.getElementById('passwordForm').reset();
        }

        // ============================================
        // LANGUAGE SELECTION
        // ============================================
        
        let selectedLanguage = 'en';
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.language-option').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const lang = this.dataset.lang;
                const langNames = {
                    'en': 'English',
                    'hi': 'Hindi (हिन्दी)',
                    'es': 'Spanish (Español)',
                    'fr': 'French (Français)'
                };
                
                // Update checkmarks
                document.querySelectorAll('[id^="langCheck-"]').forEach(el => {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });
                document.getElementById(`langCheck-${lang}`).style.display = 'inline';
                
                selectedLanguage = lang;
                document.getElementById('currentLanguage').textContent = langNames[lang] || 'English';
                
                showToast(`Language changed to ${langNames[lang]}`, 'success');
                
                // Close modal after short delay
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('languageModal'));
                    modal.hide();
                }, 500);
            });
        });

        // ============================================
        // CURRENCY SELECTION
        // ============================================
        
        let selectedCurrency = 'INR';
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.currency-option').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const currency = this.dataset.currency;
                const currencySymbols = {
                    'INR': '₹',
                    'USD': '$',
                    'EUR': '€',
                    'GBP': '£'
                };
                const currencyNames = {
                    'INR': 'INR (₹)',
                    'USD': 'USD ($)',
                    'EUR': 'EUR (€)',
                    'GBP': 'GBP (£)'
                };
                
                // Update checkmarks
                document.querySelectorAll('[id^="currCheck-"]').forEach(el => {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });
                document.getElementById(`currCheck-${currency}`).style.display = 'inline';
                
                selectedCurrency = currency;
                document.getElementById('currentCurrency').textContent = currencyNames[currency] || 'INR (₹)';
                
                showToast(`Currency changed to ${currencyNames[currency]}`, 'success');
                
                // Close modal after short delay
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('currencyModal'));
                    modal.hide();
                }, 500);
            });
        });

        // ============================================
        // TWO FACTOR AUTH TOGGLE
        // ============================================
        
        document.getElementById('twoFactorToggle').addEventListener('change', function() {
            const status = this.checked ? 'enabled' : 'disabled';
            showToast(`Two-factor authentication ${status}`, 'info');
        });

        // ============================================
        // LOGOUT
        // ============================================
        
        function logout() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
                // Call logout API
                fetch('/api/auth/logout.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                }).catch(() => {
                    // Ignore errors on logout
                });
                
                localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                window.location.replace('/login.html');
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // LOAD SAVED PREFERENCES
        // ============================================
        
        // Load notification preference
        const notifPref = localStorage.getItem('notifications_enabled');
        if (notifPref !== null) {
            document.getElementById('notifToggle').checked = notifPref === 'true';
        }
        
        console.log('✅ Settings page loaded');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css">
    
    <style>
        /* ============================================
           SIGNUP PAGE STYLES
           ============================================ */
        
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: #0a0e1a;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 16px;
            position: relative;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(108, 60, 225, 0.08), transparent 50%),
                        radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(155, 89, 182, 0.05), transparent 40%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }
        
        .signup-container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 440px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .signup-card {
            background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 28px;
            padding: 40px 32px;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
        }
        
        .signup-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6C3CE1, #9B59B6, #6C3CE1);
            background-size: 200% 100%;
            animation: shimmerBorder 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        
        @keyframes shimmerBorder {
            0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }
        
        @keyframes fadeInUp {

        /* ============================================

           ============================================ */
        
        @media (max-width: 480px) {

            }
```
