```html
                        <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                        <p class="text-secondary mt-2">Loading details...</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- BOTTOM NAV -->
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="withdraw.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="withdraw">
                <i class="fas fa-money-bill-wave"></i>
                <span>Withdraw</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Toast Container -->
    <div class="toast-container"></div>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
        
        if (!token || !userData) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }
        
        console.log('✅ User authenticated, loading withdraw page');
        
        // ============================================
        // STATE
        // ============================================
        
        let currentBalance = 0;
        let paymentMethods = [];
        let selectedMethod = '';
        let requirements = {
            minWithdrawal: 50,
            maxWithdrawal: 50000,
            requiredReferrals: 5,
            requiredTasks: 10
        };
        let withdrawalHistory = [];
        
        // ============================================
        // LOAD DATA
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadAllData() {
            await loadDashboardData();
            await loadPaymentMethods();
            await loadWithdrawalHistory();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // LOAD DASHBOARD DATA - FIXED
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadDashboardData() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/user/dashboard.php', {
            headers: {
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
            }
        });
        
        if (response.status === 401) {
            localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
            localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
            return;
        }
        
        const data = await response.json();
        
        if (data.success) {
            const user = data.data.user || {};
            currentBalance = user.wallet_balance || 0;
            
            document.getElementById('availableBalance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(currentBalance);
            
            // ✅ FIX: Get settings from API (not hardcoded)
            const settings = data.data.settings || {};
            requirements.minWithdrawal = parseFloat(settings.min_withdrawal) || 50;
            requirements.maxWithdrawal = parseFloat(settings.max_withdrawal) || 50000;
            requirements.requiredReferrals = parseInt(settings.required_referrals) || 5;
            requirements.requiredTasks = parseInt(settings.required_tasks) || 10;
            
            console.log('📊 Withdrawal Settings:', requirements);
            
            const stats = data.data.stats || {};
            const referrals = stats.referrals || {};
            const tasks = stats.tasks || {};
            
            // ✅ FIX: Get today's stats from API
            const todayStats = data.data.today_stats || {};
            const tasksCompletedToday = todayStats.tasks_completed || 0;
            
            // ✅ FIX: Get period data from API
            const periodData = data.data.period || {};
            
            renderRequirements({
                balance: currentBalance,
                referrals: referrals.total || 0,
                tasks: tasks.total || 0,
                pendingWithdrawals: stats.withdrawals?.pending_count || 0,
                tasksSinceLastWithdrawal: periodData.tasks_since_last_withdrawal || 0,
                referralsSinceLastWithdrawal: periodData.referrals_since_last_withdrawal || 0,
                verifiedReferralsSinceLastWithdrawal: periodData.verified_referrals_since_last_withdrawal || 0,
                lastWithdrawalDate: periodData.last_withdrawal_date || 'Never',
                tasksCompletedToday: tasksCompletedToday,
                // ✅ ADD: Also pass today's earnings
                todayEarnings: todayStats.earnings || 0
            });
            
            document.getElementById('pendingWithdrawals').textContent = stats.withdrawals?.pending_count || 0;
            document.getElementById('balanceHint').textContent = 
                `Min: ₹${Math.round(requirements.minWithdrawal)} | Max: ₹${Math.round(requirements.maxWithdrawal)} | Available: ₹${Math.round(currentBalance)}`;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Load dashboard error:', error);
        showToast('Error loading data', 'error');
    }
}
        
       // ============================================
// ✅ RENDER REQUIREMENTS - SIMPLIFIED & CLEAN
// ============================================

function renderRequirements(data) {
    const container = document.getElementById('requirementsList');
    
    // Get requirements from settings
    const requiredTasks = requirements.requiredTasks || 10;
    const requiredReferrals = requirements.requiredReferrals || 5;
    const minWithdrawal = requirements.minWithdrawal || 50;
    const maxWithdrawal = requirements.maxWithdrawal || 50000;
    
    // Get data values
    const tasksSinceLast = data.tasksSinceLastWithdrawal || 0;
    const verifiedReferralsSinceLast = data.verifiedReferralsSinceLastWithdrawal || 0;
    const referralsSinceLast = data.referralsSinceLastWithdrawal || 0;
    const lastWithdrawalDate = data.lastWithdrawalDate || 'Never';
    const tasksCompletedToday = data.tasksCompletedToday || 0;
    const todayEarnings = data.todayEarnings || 0;
    const balance = data.balance || 0;
    const pendingWithdrawals = data.pendingWithdrawals || 0;
    const totalTasks = data.tasks || 0;
    const totalReferrals = data.referrals || 0;
    
    // Check requirements
    const tasksMet = tasksSinceLast >= requiredTasks;
    const referralsMet = verifiedReferralsSinceLast >= requiredReferrals;
    const balanceMet = balance >= minWithdrawal;
    const pendingMet = pendingWithdrawals === 0;
    const allMet = tasksMet && referralsMet && balanceMet && pendingMet;
    
    // Calculate progress
    const tasksProgress = Math.min((tasksSinceLast / requiredTasks) * 100, 100);
    const referralsProgress = Math.min((verifiedReferralsSinceLast / requiredReferrals) * 100, 100);
    
    // Update status badge
    const statusBadge = document.getElementById('requirementsStatus');
    if (statusBadge) {
        if (allMet) {
            statusBadge.textContent = '✅ All Met';
            statusBadge.className = 'badge bg-success float-end';
        } else {
            statusBadge.textContent = '⚠️ Pending';
            statusBadge.className = 'badge bg-warning float-end';
        }
    }
    
    let html = '';
    
    // ============================================
    // 1. QUICK STATS - At a glance
    // ============================================
    
    html += `
        <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
            <div class="col-3">
                <div class="text-center p-2 bg-dark rounded">
                    <div class="fw-bold text-success">₹${Math.round(balance)}</div>
                    <small class="text-secondary">Balance</small>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-3">
                <div class="text-center p-2 bg-dark rounded">
                    <div class="fw-bold text-primary">${tasksSinceLast}</div>
                    <small class="text-secondary">Tasks</small>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-3">
                <div class="text-center p-2 bg-dark rounded">
                    <div class="fw-bold text-purple" style="color: #a78bfa;">${verifiedReferralsSinceLast}</div>
                    <small class="text-secondary">Referrals</small>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-3">
                <div class="text-center p-2 bg-dark rounded">
                    <div class="fw-bold ${pendingMet ? 'text-success' : 'text-warning'}">${pendingWithdrawals}</div>
                    <small class="text-secondary">Pending</small>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    
    // ============================================
    // 2. PROGRESS BARS - Visual progress
    // ============================================
    
    html += `
        <div class="mb-3">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between small">
                <span class="text-secondary"><i class="fas fa-tasks me-1" style="color: #8B5CF6;"></i> Tasks Progress</span>
                <span class="${tasksMet ? 'text-success' : 'text-warning'}">${tasksSinceLast} / ${requiredTasks}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress" style="height: 8px; background: #1a2234; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;">
                <div class="progress-bar" style="width: ${tasksProgress}%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6C3CE1, #9B59B6); transition: width 0.6s ease;"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="mb-3">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between small">
                <span class="text-secondary"><i class="fas fa-users me-1" style="color: #34d399;"></i> Referrals Progress</span>
                <span class="${referralsMet ? 'text-success' : 'text-warning'}">${verifiedReferralsSinceLast} / ${requiredReferrals}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress" style="height: 8px; background: #1a2234; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;">
                <div class="progress-bar" style="width: ${referralsProgress}%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #34d399); transition: width 0.6s ease;"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    
    // ============================================
    // 3. REQUIREMENT CHECKLIST - Simple list
    // ============================================
    
    const checklist = [
        { 
            label: `💰 Minimum Balance (₹${minWithdrawal})`, 
            met: balanceMet,
            detail: `₹${Math.round(balance)} available`
        },
        { 
            label: `📋 ${requiredTasks} Tasks Completed`, 
            met: tasksMet,
            detail: `${tasksSinceLast} completed`
        },
        { 
            label: `👥 ${requiredReferrals} Verified Referrals`, 
            met: referralsMet,
            detail: `${verifiedReferralsSinceLast} verified`
        },
        { 
            label: `⏳ No Pending Withdrawals`, 
            met: pendingMet,
            detail: pendingMet ? '✅ Clear' : `${pendingWithdrawals} pending`
        }
    ];
    
    html += `
        <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
            <small class="text-secondary d-block mb-2">📋 Requirements Checklist</small>
    `;
    
    checklist.forEach(item => {
        const icon = item.met ? '✅' : '❌';
        const color = item.met ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger';
        html += `
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center py-1" style="border-bottom: 1px solid #1a2234;">
                <span class="${color}">${icon} ${item.label}</span>
                <span class="small ${color}">${item.detail}</span>
            </div>
        `;
    });
    
    html += `</div>`;
    
    // ============================================
    // 4. STATUS MESSAGE
    // ============================================
    
    if (allMet) {
        html += `
            <div class="mt-3 p-2 text-center" style="background: rgba(16,185,129,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.15); border-radius: 8px;">
                <span class="text-success fw-bold">🎉 All requirements met! You can withdraw now.</span>
            </div>
        `;
    } else {
        const missing = [];
        if (!tasksMet) missing.push(`${requiredTasks - tasksSinceLast} more tasks`);
        if (!referralsMet) missing.push(`${requiredReferrals - verifiedReferralsSinceLast} more referrals`);
        if (!balanceMet) missing.push(`₹${minWithdrawal - balance} more balance`);
        if (!pendingMet) missing.push('Complete pending withdrawal');
        
        html += `
            <div class="mt-3 p-2 text-center" style="background: rgba(245,158,11,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.15); border-radius: 8px;">
                <span class="text-warning fw-bold">⚠️ Need: ${missing.join(', ')}</span>
            </div>
        `;
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // 5. LAST WITHDRAWAL INFO
    // ============================================
    
    html += `
        <div class="mt-2 text-center">
            <small class="text-secondary">
                <i class="fas fa-info-circle me-1"></i>
                Last withdrawal: <strong>${lastWithdrawalDate}</strong>
                <span class="mx-1">•</span>
                <span style="color: #60a5fa;">🔄 Resets after each withdrawal</span>
            </small>
        </div>
    `;
    
    // ============================================
    // SET BUTTON STATE
    // ============================================
    
    container.innerHTML = html;
    
    const withdrawBtn = document.getElementById('withdrawBtn');
    if (withdrawBtn) {
        withdrawBtn.disabled = !allMet;
        if (allMet) {
            withdrawBtn.textContent = '💰 Request Withdrawal';
            withdrawBtn.className = 'btn-withdraw';
        } else {
            withdrawBtn.textContent = '🔒 Complete Requirements';
            withdrawBtn.className = 'btn-withdraw';
        }
    }
    
    return allMet;
}
        
        // ============================================
        // LOAD PAYMENT METHODS
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadPaymentMethods() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/withdraw/methods.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    paymentMethods = data.data || [];
                    renderPaymentMethods(paymentMethods);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load payment methods error:', error);
                showToast('Error loading payment methods', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // RENDER PAYMENT METHODS
        // ============================================
        
        function renderPaymentMethods(methods) {
            const container = document.getElementById('paymentMethodsContainer');
            
            if (!methods || methods.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-12 text-center text-secondary py-3">
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i> No payment methods available
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = methods.map(method => {
                let iconHtml = '';
                if (method.icon) {
                    if (method.icon.startsWith('fa-')) {
                        iconHtml = `<i class="fas ${method.icon}" style="font-size: 28px;"></i>`;
                    } else {
                        iconHtml = `<img src="${method.icon}" alt="${method.display_name}" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; object-fit: contain;">`;
                    }
                } else {
                    iconHtml = `<i class="fas fa-credit-card" style="font-size: 28px;"></i>`;
                }
                
                return `
                    <div class="col-4 col-md-3">
                        <div class="payment-method-btn" data-method="${method.method_name}" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('${method.method_name}')">
                            <div class="logo">${iconHtml}</div>
                            <div class="name">${method.display_name}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // SELECT PAYMENT METHOD
        // ============================================
        
        window.selectPaymentMethod = function(methodName) {
            selectedMethod = methodName;
            document.getElementById('selectedPaymentMethod').value = methodName;
            
            document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.method === methodName);
            });
            
            showAccountDetails(methodName);
            checkWithdrawEligibility();
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // SHOW ACCOUNT DETAILS
        // ============================================
        
        function showAccountDetails(methodName) {
            const container = document.getElementById('accountDetailsContainer');
            
            const method = paymentMethods.find(m => m.method_name === methodName);
            if (!method) {
                container.innerHTML = `<p class="text-secondary small">Please select a payment method</p>`;
                return;
            }
            
            let fields = '';
            
            switch (methodName) {
                case 'upi':
                    fields = `
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">UPI ID <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="upi_id" placeholder="example@upi" required>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                    
                case 'phonepe':
                case 'paytm':
                case 'googlepay':
                    fields = `
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">Phone Number <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="tel" class="form-control" id="phone" placeholder="Enter phone number" required>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                    
                case 'bank_transfer':
                    fields = `
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">Account Number <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="account_number" placeholder="Enter account number" required>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">IFSC Code <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="ifsc" placeholder="Enter IFSC code" required>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">Account Holder Name <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="account_holder" placeholder="Enter account holder name" required>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                    
                case 'usdt':
                    fields = `
                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <label class="form-label">USDT (TRC20) Address <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="wallet_address" placeholder="Enter USDT address" required>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                    
                default:
                    fields = `<p class="text-secondary small">No details required for ${method.display_name}</p>`;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = fields;
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // CHECK WITHDRAW ELIGIBILITY
        // ============================================
        
        function checkWithdrawEligibility() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('withdrawBtn');
            const amount = parseInt(document.getElementById('amountInput').value);
            
            const isAmountValid = amount >= requirements.minWithdrawal && amount <= currentBalance && amount <= requirements.maxWithdrawal;
            const hasMethod = selectedMethod !== '';
            
            btn.disabled = !(isAmountValid && hasMethod);
        }
        
        document.getElementById('amountInput').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const val = parseInt(this.value);
            if (val > currentBalance) {
                this.value = currentBalance;
            }
            checkWithdrawEligibility();
        });
        
        // ============================================
        // LOAD WITHDRAWAL HISTORY
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadWithdrawalHistory() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/withdraw/history.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    withdrawalHistory = data.data || [];
                    renderWithdrawalHistory(withdrawalHistory);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load withdrawal history error:', error);
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // RENDER WITHDRAWAL HISTORY
        // ============================================
        
        function renderWithdrawalHistory(history) {
            const container = document.getElementById('withdrawalHistory');
            
            if (!history || history.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="card-body text-center text-secondary py-4">
                        <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-2"></i>
                        <p class="mb-0">No withdrawal history</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            let html = '<div class="card-body p-0">';
            
            history.slice(0, 10).forEach(item => {
                const statusClass = item.status || 'pending';
                const date = new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString();
                const method = item.payment_method || 'N/A';
                const amount = Math.round(item.amount || 0);
                
                html += `
                    <div class="withdrawal-item" onclick="showWithdrawalDetail(${item.id})">
                        <div class="info">
                            <div class="amount">₹${amount}</div>
                            <div class="method">${method}</div>
                            <div class="date">${date}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span class="status ${statusClass}">${statusClass.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}</span>
                            <i class="fas fa-chevron-right text-secondary ms-2" style="font-size: 12px;"></i>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            
            html += '</div>';
            container.innerHTML = html;
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // SHOW WITHDRAWAL DETAIL MODAL - UPDATED
        // ============================================
        
        window.showWithdrawalDetail = async function(withdrawalId) {
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('withdrawalDetailModal'));
            const body = document.getElementById('modalBody');
            
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div class="text-center py-3">
                    <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                    <p class="text-secondary mt-2">Loading details...</p>
                </div>
            `;
            
            modal.show();
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`https://paisa-pay.online/api/withdraw/detail.php?id=${withdrawalId}`, {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                const result = await response.json();
                
                if (result.success) {
                    renderWithdrawalDetail(result.data);
                } else {
                    body.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-4">
                            <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle fa-2x text-danger mb-2"></i>
                            <p class="text-danger">${result.message || 'Error loading details'}</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                body.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="text-center py-4">
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle fa-2x text-danger mb-2"></i>
                        <p class="text-danger">Error loading details</p>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // RENDER WITHDRAWAL DETAIL - FIXED
        // ============================================
        
        function renderWithdrawalDetail(data) {
            const body = document.getElementById('modalBody');
            
            const statusClass = data.status || 'pending';
            const statusLabels = {
                'pending': 'Pending',
                'under_review': 'Under Review',
                'approved': 'Approved',
                'rejected': 'Rejected',
                'paid': 'Paid'
            };
            
            let html = `
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-3">
                    <div>
                        <h5 class="text-white mb-0">₹${Math.round(data.amount).toLocaleString()}</h5>
                        <small class="text-secondary">Request #${data.id}</small>
                    </div>
                    <span class="status-badge ${statusClass}">${statusLabels[data.status] || data.status.toUpperCase()}</span>
                </div>
                
                <div class="detail-row">
                    <span class="label">Payment Method</span>
                    <span class="value">${data.payment_method || 'N/A'}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="detail-row">
                    <span class="label">Requested On</span>
                    <span class="value">${new Date(data.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
            `;
            
            // Show processed date if available
            if (data.processed_at) {
                html += `
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="label">Processed On</span>
                        <span class="value">${new Date(data.processed_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            // Show admin notes for rejection or approval
            if (data.admin_notes) {
                const isRejected = data.status === 'rejected';
                const noteClass = isRejected ? 'text-danger' : 'text-success';
                const noteIcon = isRejected ? 'fa-exclamation-circle' : 'fa-check-circle';
                html += `
                    <div class="admin-notes-box">
                        <div class="admin-label">
                            <i class="fas ${noteIcon} me-1"></i> ${isRejected ? 'Rejection Reason' : 'Admin Note'}
                        </div>
                        <div class="admin-text ${isRejected ? '' : 'success'}">${data.admin_notes}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            // Build requirements HTML
            if (data.requirements) {
                const reqDetails = data.requirements.details || {};
                const allMet = data.requirements.met;
                
                html += `
                    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                        <h6 class="text-white mb-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-check-circle me-2" style="color: ${allMet ? '#10b981' : '#fbbf24'};"></i>
                            Validation Requirements ${allMet ? '✅ All Met' : '⚠️ Pending'}
                        </h6>
                        ${Object.entries(reqDetails).map(([key, req]) => `
                            <div class="detail-row">
                                <span class="label">${key.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase()}</span>
                                <span class="value ${req.met ? 'met' : 'unmet'}">
                                    ${typeof req.current === 'number' ? Math.round(req.current) : req.current} / 
                                    ${typeof req.required === 'number' ? Math.round(req.required) : req.required || req.min || req.max || 'N/A'}
                                    ${req.met ? ' ✅' : ' ❌'}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        `).join('')}
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            // ============================================
            // REFERRALS LIST WITH DETAILED STATUS - FIXED
            // ============================================
            
            if (data.referrals && data.referrals.length > 0) {
                const verifiedCount = data.referrals.filter(r => r.status === 'verified').length;
                
                html += `
                    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                        <h6 class="text-white mb-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-users me-2" style="color: #a78bfa;"></i>
                            Referrals (${verifiedCount}/${data.referrals.length} Verified)
                        </h6>
                        <div class="text-secondary small mb-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-info-circle me-1"></i> 
                            Each referral must complete 3+ tasks and verify email to be verified.
                        </div>
                `;
                
                // ✅ FIX: Properly map referrals with correct variable
                data.referrals.forEach(ref => {
                    const isVerified = ref.all_requirements_met === true || ref.status === 'verified';
                    const statusText = isVerified ? 'VERIFIED ✅' : 'PENDING ⏳';
                    const statusColor = isVerified ? 'verified' : (ref.detailed_status === 'flagged' ? 'flagged' : 'pending');
                    
                    let reasonText = '';
                    if (isVerified) {
                        reasonText = '✅ All requirements met';
                    } else {
                        const missing = [];
                        if (!ref.email_verified) missing.push('📧 Email not verified');
                        if ((ref.tasks_completed || 0) < 3) missing.push(`📝 ${3 - (ref.tasks_completed || 0)} more tasks needed`);
                        if (ref.detailed_status === 'inactive') missing.push('🕐 Inactive for 30+ days');
                        if (ref.detailed_status === 'flagged') missing.push('⚠️ Suspicious activity flagged');
                        reasonText = missing.length > 0 ? missing.join(' · ') : 'Awaiting verification';
                    }
                    
                    html += `
                        <div class="referral-list-item" style="flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 10px 0;">
                            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                                <span class="name">${ref.name || 'User'}</span>
                                <span class="status-small ${statusColor}">${statusText}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mt-1">
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8;">
                                    <i class="fas fa-tasks me-1"></i> ${ref.tasks_completed || 0} tasks
                                    ${ref.email_verified ? ' · ✅ Email verified' : ' · ❌ Email not verified'}
                                </span>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; ${isVerified ? 'color: #10b981;' : 'color: #f59e0b;'}">
                                    ${reasonText}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                
                if (verifiedCount === 0) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="alert alert-warning bg-warning bg-opacity-10 border border-warning border-opacity-25 text-warning small mt-2" style="border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px;">
                            <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>
                            <strong>No verified referrals yet.</strong> 
                            ${data.referrals.length > 0 ? 'Your referrals need to complete tasks and verify their email.' : 'You need to refer more users.'}
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
                
                html += `</div>`;
            }
            
            // Build tasks summary with detailed breakdown
            if (data.tasks_summary) {
                const tasksMet = data.tasks_summary.completed >= data.tasks_summary.required;
                html += `
                    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                        <h6 class="text-white mb-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-tasks me-2" style="color: #60a5fa;"></i>
                            Tasks Summary
                        </h6>
                        <div class="detail-row">
                            <span class="label">Tasks Completed</span>
                            <span class="value ${tasksMet ? 'met' : 'unmet'}">
                                ${data.tasks_summary.completed} / ${data.tasks_summary.required}
                                ${tasksMet ? ' ✅' : ' ❌'}
                                ${!tasksMet ? `<span style="font-size: 11px; color: #f59e0b; display: block;">${data.tasks_summary.required - data.tasks_summary.completed} more tasks needed</span>` : ''}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="detail-row">
                            <span class="label">Tasks This Month</span>
                            <span class="value">${data.tasks_summary.this_month || 0}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            // Build validation notes
            if (data.validation_notes) {
                html += `
                    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                        <h6 class="text-white mb-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-shield-alt me-2" style="color: #fbbf24;"></i>
                            Validation Notes
                        </h6>
                        <div class="text-secondary small" style="white-space: pre-line;">${data.validation_notes}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            // Status message for pending/under review
            if (data.status === 'under_review' || data.status === 'pending') {
                html += `
                    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                        <div class="status-message info">
                            <i class="fas fa-clock me-2"></i>
                            Your request is being reviewed. This usually takes 24-48 hours.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            body.innerHTML = html;
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // SUBMIT WITHDRAWAL
        // ============================================
        
        document.getElementById('withdrawForm').addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            const amount = parseInt(document.getElementById('amountInput').value);
            
            if (!amount || amount < requirements.minWithdrawal) {
                showToast(`Minimum withdrawal amount is ₹${Math.round(requirements.minWithdrawal)}`, 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            if (amount > currentBalance) {
                showToast(`Insufficient balance. Available: ₹${Math.round(currentBalance)}`, 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            if (!selectedMethod) {
                showToast('Please select a payment method', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const accountDetails = {};
            const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#accountDetailsContainer input');
            inputs.forEach(input => {
                if (input.value.trim()) {
                    accountDetails[input.id] = input.value.trim();
                }
            });
            
            if (Object.keys(accountDetails).length === 0) {
                showToast('Please fill in your account details', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const btn = document.getElementById('withdrawBtn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm me-2"></span>Processing...';
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/withdraw/request.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        amount: amount,
                        payment_method: selectedMethod,
                        account_details: accountDetails
                    })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    showToast('✅ Withdrawal request submitted!', 'success');

                    if (data.reset_message) {
                        showToast('🔄 ' + data.reset_message, 'info');
                    }
    
                    document.getElementById('amountInput').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('selectedPaymentMethod').value = '';
                    document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.getElementById('accountDetailsContainer').innerHTML = '<p class="text-secondary small">Please select a payment method</p>';
                    selectedMethod = '';
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Request Withdrawal';
                    
                    await loadAllData();
                } else {
                    showToast(data.message || 'Withdrawal failed', 'error');
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Request Withdrawal';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Withdrawal error:', error);
                showToast('Error submitting withdrawal', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Request Withdrawal';
            }
        });
        
        // ============================================
        // TOAST
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 4000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // LOAD ON PAGE LOAD
        // ============================================
        
        loadAllData();
        
        setInterval(() => {
            if (!document.hidden) {
                loadAllData();
            }
        }, 30000);
        
        console.log('✅ Withdraw page loaded successfully');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }

        const API_BASE = '/api';
        const WITHDRAWAL_STATUS = `${API_BASE}/withdraw/status.php`;
        const WITHDRAWAL_HISTORY = `${API_BASE}/withdraw/history.php`;

        async function loadWithdrawalStatus() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(WITHDRAWAL_STATUS, {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
                });

                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }

                const result = await response.json();
                
                if (result.success) {
                    renderStatus(result.data);
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('statusContent').innerHTML = `
                        <div class="status-card text-center">
                            <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-3"></i>
                            <h6 class="text-white">No Withdrawal History</h6>
                            <p class="text-secondary">You haven't made any withdrawal requests yet.</p>
                            <a href="withdraw.html" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Request Withdrawal</a>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error:', error);
            }
        }

        function renderStatus(data) {
            const container = document.getElementById('statusContent');
            
            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="status-card text-center">
                        <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-3"></i>
                        <h6 class="text-white">No Withdrawal History</h6>
                        <p class="text-secondary">You haven't made any withdrawal requests yet.</p>
                        <a href="withdraw.html" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Request Withdrawal</a>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = data.map(item => `
                <div class="status-card">
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-3">
                        <div>
                            <h6 class="text-white mb-0">₹${Math.round(item.amount).toLocaleString()}</h6>
                            <small class="text-secondary">#${item.id} · ${new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</small>
                        </div>
                        <span class="status-badge ${item.status}">${item.status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}</span>
                    </div>
                    
                    ${item.status === 'under_review' || item.status === 'pending' ? `
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <small class="text-secondary">🔍 Your request is being reviewed. This usually takes 24-48 hours.</small>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                    
                    ${item.status === 'rejected' ? `
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <small class="text-danger">❌ ${item.admin_notes || 'Request rejected. Please contact support.'}</small>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                    
                    ${item.requirements ? `
                        <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-top border-secondary">
                            <small class="text-secondary">Requirements Check</small>
                            ${Object.entries(item.requirements.details || {}).map(([key, req]) => `
                                <div class="requirement-item">
                                    <span class="label">${key.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}</span>
                                    <span class="value ${req.met ? 'met' : 'unmet'}">
                                        ${req.current} / ${req.required || req.min || req.max}
                                        ${req.met ? '✅' : '❌'}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        loadWithdrawalStatus();
        console.log('✅ Withdrawal Status page loaded');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```
